description: Create an Edge Shield widget to protect a form or page from bots. Free. Returns the sitekey, the secret (shown once — store it server-side), and a ready-to-paste embed snippet.

dry_run.description: Preview the action without executing it. Returns what would happen, including cost estimates. Always dry-run first for anything that costs money.

hostnames.description: Hostnames allowed to use this widget, e.g. ["example.com"]. Empty = any hostname.

mode.description: managed: invisible for humans, one-click check for suspicious traffic (default)

name: edge_create_shield_widget
